title: Side setback, walls up to 3.5 m high (R50 and above)
text: C3.4.1 Buildings are set back from lot boundaries in accordance with Table 3.4a. Refer Figure 3.4a, b, c. Table 3.4a Lot boundary setbacks, side setback: R5 and above, Wall height up to 3.5m: 1m.

replaces.note: R2 10 m and R2.5 7.5 m unchanged; R5+ now by wall height only
wall length and major-opening dimensions dropped

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: No pedestrian access way reduction above R40. R100-SL added to coding: Table 2.10a does not modify Table 3.4a setbacks, so the R5-and-above row applies, and Table 2A (draft p7, extract lines 182-186) shows the 1m/1.5m/2m cells spanning R5 to R100-SL. Applies only where the building has walls up to 3.5 m high (condition on building.has_walls_to_3_5m); the band does not depend on the building's maximum wall height.

verified.note: R100-SL: Table 2A (p7) prints the side setback cells spanning R5 to R100-SL; Table 2.10a does not modify C3.4.1.
